description: Move one work order to a new status: approve (waitingApproval to readyForProduction), mark_ready (open or onHold to readyForProduction), hold (open to onHold), or cancel (any work order not started, completed or cancelled; returns its reserved stock to available stock and frees its machines). A work order a manufacturing order generated is not cancelled here: cancel the manufacturing order. Starting and completing production use execute_manufacturing_step. Preview first; the preview shows the status change, the stock a cancel releases and the pick lists left open. Requires Write + manufacturing.execute on an unpinned operator credential. In-app assistants get a confirm card the user applies.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
